note: Both sets correctly capture the two level markers (GRADE LEVEL 0' - 0" and FINISHED FLOOR 2' - 9 1/2") as they appear in both the kitchen/dining section and the bedroom section, with values and quotes supported by the text layer. Set A additionally keeps the needed datum condition (finished floor relative to grade level), which the paired markers establish, whereas Set B labels the values as elevations without stating the datum. Neither set invents values or misbinds components, so the difference is small but favors A for retaining the condition.
